evidence.observation: pressure_gauge not_installed; P is null throughout, and growth requires tube pressure
Growth holds at 750.0±0.3 °C after a brief overshoot to 760.1 °C at 2520 s
Exhaust O2 is 3–7 ppm during growth after purge from 28765 ppm, which argues against a gross air leak
MFC reading matches the 100 sccm setpoint; this cannot show whether the exhaust is blocked or the tube is over-pressured
Steady at about 45% during growth, consistent with holding temperature
